opennyai_summary.facts:
The petitioner is directed to serve a copy of this revisional application upon Ms. Manisha Sharma,
Learned Advocate, who ordinarily appears on behalf of the State and also on the Learned Advocate,
who is representing the Private Opposite Party No.2.
opennyai_summary.arguments: The facts which have been narrated in the FIR/Letter of Complaint addressed to the Parnasree P.S., is falsification of events and narration of twisted facts.
opennyai_summary.17_July_2023__ANALYSIS:
Whether the same amounts to mental torture or not is to be assessed in course of investigation.
The petitioner obviously would be at liberty to bring the same to the notice of the Investigating Agency.
Having regard to the nature of the allegations which are under Sections 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code, the liberty of the petitioner, at any cost, would not be prejudiced without adhering to the guidelines as laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar.
The petitioner would be at liberty to exhaust other remedies available under the law but so far as the factual assumptions are concerned, at this stage, it is not possible for this Court to hold that no case has been made out.
opennyai_summary.17_July_2023__decision:
With the aforesaid observations, the Revisional Application, being CRR 2559 of 2023, is disposed of.
Pending application(s), if any, is also disposed of.
All parties to act on a server copy of this order duly obtained from the official website of the Hon'ble High Court, Calcutta.
Urgent Photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties, subject to compliance with all requisite formalities.

2.  It is submitted that the present petitioner has been unnecessarily implicated in this case and in view of such and also considering the fact that the investigation has already been completed, the present application for anticipatory bail may be considered in favour of the petitioner.
It is submitted that there are sufficient incrementing materials against the petitioner who is not only tortured the victim informant but also neglected her and duped her.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
4. Regard being had to such facts and submissions, factum of permanent residence of the petitioner,
nature of allegation, the fact that there is always hope of compromise in matrimonial disputes and such compromise is always in the interest of the family and society and completion of investigation,
it is directed that the petitioner shall surrender before the learned ACJM, South 24 Parganas at Alipore in the aforesaid P.S. case within 15 days from today.
On his surrender and application for bail, he shall be released on bail by the aforesaid Court on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.
Accordingly, the prayer for the anticipatory bail is allowed.
6. The application being CRM(A) 3675 of 2023 is disposed of.
